title: Prohibited AI practices
obligation: Systems must not use prohibited AI practices such as manipulative or exploitative techniques.

title: Risk management system
obligation: Providers shall establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system.

title: Data governance
obligation: Providers shall apply data governance practices over training, validation and testing data.

title: Record keeping and logging
obligation: Providers shall keep logs automatically generated by high-risk AI systems.

title: Transparency and information
obligation: Providers shall supply clear information so users can understand and use the system correctly.

title: Human oversight
obligation: High-risk AI systems shall be designed so natural persons can effectively oversee them.

title: Accuracy and robustness
obligation: High-risk AI systems shall achieve appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity.

title: Transparency for limited-risk systems
obligation: Providers shall ensure users are informed when they interact with an AI system.

title: Governance policies
obligation: Organisations shall establish governance policies and accountability for AI risk.

title: Map intended purpose
obligation: Organisations shall document the intended purpose and context of each AI system.

title: Measure bias and fairness
obligation: Organisations shall measure bias and fairness risks of AI systems.

title: Measure performance
obligation: Organisations shall measure system performance against defined metrics.

title: Incident response
obligation: Organisations shall operate an incident response process for AI failures.

title: Monitor residual risk
obligation: Organisations shall monitor residual risk after controls are applied.

title: Risk and opportunity actions
obligation: Organisations shall plan actions to address AI risks and opportunities.

title: Documented information
obligation: Organisations shall maintain documented information required by the AI management system.

title: AI system lifecycle control
obligation: Organisations shall control AI system processes across their lifecycle.

title: Monitoring and measurement
obligation: Organisations shall monitor, measure and evaluate AI system performance.

title: Continual improvement
obligation: Organisations shall continually improve the AI management system.
